instructions: Linear A Lexicon holds Tom di Mino’s proposed readings of Linear A as Minoan, an archaic Semitic language. Give each reading and translation as his proposal, with its tier, and name any rival mentioned. Confirmed fixes function, not etymology. Never invent a reading, translation or record. Compose no new Minoan text. Linear A only. Report not-found plainly. Named item: get_. Sets: list_/find_. Statistical tests: kernel_summary, run_*_kernel. Otherwise: search, then fetch. Cite each url.

tools.name: search
tools.title: Search the Linear A Lexicon
tools.description: Use this when you cannot name the record: an English meaning (wine), a scholar, a topic or an uncertain spelling, across the Lexicon and its wiki. Returns ids for fetch. Do not use for a word, name or document you can name exactly (get_word, get_name, get_text) or for filtered lists.

query.description: A word, document number, name, root, meaning or scholar.

url.description: The page on linear-a.ai to cite.

tools.name: fetch
tools.title: Read a Linear A Lexicon record
tools.description: Use this when you need the full text of a search result. Long pages come in parts, and each part names the next id. Do not use to discover records.

id.description: An id from search, or the next id a part names.

url.description: The page on linear-a.ai to cite.
